assets.use: Medicine hall west of the central lotus court
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset, NOT a screenshot or a mockup. Create a single freestanding ornate Ayutthaya Thai Buddhist viharn temple sprite, on a genuinely transparent background. High-detail hand-painted pixel-informed 2.5D RPG environment art: warm ivory aged plaster, carved golden Thai gable and chofa finials, layered terracotta red roof tiles with individual texture, dark wooden central door with gold carving, low broad pale stone stairway and paired small stone guardian lions, small carved balustrade. Exquisite cohesive crisp illustrated detail with dark warm edge definition, no blur, no photographic rendering, no low-poly primitive look. Fixed orthographic game camera looking down about 55 degrees from the south, facade faces camera with a little right-side visible, straight vertical walls, compatible with a top-down 2.5D game. Building occupies 90% of image with generous transparent margin so every roof finial is fully contained. Whole building including small foundation plinth, isolated; no ground tile, no landscape, no people, no other buildings, no text or HUD, no drop shadow outside its base. Soft warm daylight from upper left, ambient occlusion baked into carvings. Building width roughly equals overall height. Intended as one reusable layered sprite for an original Thai fantasy game. Transparent canvas.
